buildCommand: if [ -n "$SUPABASE_URL" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ]; then echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL" > .env && echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" >> .env; elif [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="$SUPABASE_URL" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"
installCommand: if [ -d "flutter" ]; then cd flutter && git pull && cd .. ; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable flutter; fi && flutter/bin/flutter doctor && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web
